entities.name: Truncated 5G-S-TMSI configuration
entities.description: Information element that provides configuration for truncated 5G-S-TMSI used in control plane CIoT 5GS optimizations.

entities.name: UE is in NB-N1 mode
entities.description: Condition that the UE must be operating in NB-N1 mode.

entities.name: UE requests control plane CIoT 5GS optimization
entities.description: Condition that the UE has requested control plane CIoT 5GS optimization in the 5GS update type IE of REGISTRATION REQUEST message.

entities.name: AMF accepts requested CIoT 5GS optimization
entities.description: Condition that the AMF decides to accept the requested CIoT 5GS optimization.

entities.name: Network configured to provide truncated 5G-S-TMSI configuration
entities.description: Condition that the network is configured to provide the truncated 5G-S-TMSI configuration for control plane CIoT 5GS optimizations.

entities.name: 5GS update type
entities.description: Information element in REGISTRATION REQUEST message that indicates requested optimizations including control plane CIoT 5GS optimization.

entities.name: REGISTRATION REQUEST
entities.description: NAS message sent by UE to initiate registration procedure.

relations.description: REGISTRATION REQUEST message contains the 5GS update type IE.
Inclusion of Truncated 5G-S-TMSI configuration IE is guarded by condition that UE is in NB-N1 mode.
Inclusion of Truncated 5G-S-TMSI configuration IE is guarded by condition that UE requested control plane CIoT 5GS optimization.
Inclusion of Truncated 5G-S-TMSI configuration IE is guarded by condition that AMF accepts the requested CIoT 5GS optimization.
Inclusion of Truncated 5G-S-TMSI configuration IE is guarded by condition that network is configured to provide this configuration.
